crop_policy: RGB native-size crop, floor xmin/ymin, ceil xmax/ymax; reuse existing verified v2 crops
coordinate_origin: source xyxy used directly; author VOC origin unconfirmed, no invented correction
similarity_policy: Conservative constraint, not duplicate proof or authenticated flight identity. Retain nonidentical images.
content_policy: Sampled visual review only; do not auto-label low-contrast or tiny targets as empty.
split_policy: Respect existing scene buckets and observed similarity links. Unknown old-source identity stays in one unresolved class bucket. No random frame split fallback.
